Name: Save Anywhere

Install[/size]
[/s][list=1]
[*][s][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/s]
[*][s]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/s]
[*][s]Run the game using SMAPI.[/s]

[size=5]How To Use[/size]
Press K to save anywhere. Edit the config.json file in a text editor to change the key (it will appear once you run the game), if you have GMCM use it instead.

[size=5]Things Fixed:[/size]
NPC Schedules. [color=#00ff00]✔ Fixed[/color]
Custom Maps Compatibility. [color=#00ff00]✔ Fixed[/color]
Custom NPC Compatibility. [color=#00ff00]✔ Fixed[/color]
Custom Items Compatibility. [color=#00ff00]✔ Fixed[/color]
Custom Buildings Compatibility. [color=#00ff00]✔ Fixed[/color]
Buffs. [color=#00ff00]✔ Fixed[/color]
Saving In Bed. ﻿[color=#00ff00]✔ Fixed[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]Freezing On Saving.[/color][color=#00ff00] ✔ Fixed[/color]
Animals Not Getting Inside. [color=#00ff00]✔ Fixed[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4]Saves Unsynchronized Between Computers On The Same Steam Account.[/color][color=#00ff00] ✔ Fixed
[/color]Custom Weather Cycle Compatibility. [color=#00ff00]✔ Fixed[/color]


[size=4]Created by Aredjay, RealSweetPanda, and Omegasis
[/size]
[size=5]Mod Authors:[/size]
Save anywhere has an official API with SMAPI! If you are a mod author you can use this to hopefully solve some of the compatibility issues!
The source code for that is [url=https://github.com/RealSweetPanda/SaveAnywhereRedux/blob/main/Framework/SaveAnywhereAPI.cs]here[/url]﻿.
[size=5]Notes[/size]
The mod should now work with map extension mods, modded characters, modded items, etc in the newest update. If it doesn't, report it and we can fix it. 

As much as we want to make the mod stable, this mod might crash and cause issues. just be aware and if it occurs just report it and we will fix it!
